CustomField.description: 21 Sep 2026 (Charlie Murray, VARO Partners): the words the Benefiting Group sentence uses when the group is described only by its type. Reads Benefitting Group Type first, then Law.com BG Group - the field Law.com reps actually fill on the segmented line (54 lines last year) and which the form previously ignored. Corporate means the in-house legal function; a law firm or consultancy means the organisation.
CustomField.formula: IF(TEXT(Benefitting_Group_Type__c) = "Corporate", "in-house legal function", IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Benefitting_Group_Type__c))), "organisation", IF(TEXT(Law_com_BG_Group__c) = "Corporate", "in-house legal function", IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Law_com_BG_Group__c))), "organisation", ""))))
CustomField.label: Order Form: group type words
